title: Make Your Game
goal: Design YOUR dream game. Bytey will help you think it through.
mascot_lines: You've made it to the end of the lessons — and now you're a real game maker.
Pick one idea and start small. You can always add more later.
Build a tiny bit, test it, show it to a friend, then build the next bit.
Finishing one little game teaches you way more than dreaming about ten big ones.

tier3.nudge: Stuck? Try: 'A game where you ___ and the bad guys ___'.
